package app

import (
	"net/http"

	cqrshtmx "github.com/larsartmann/cqrs-htmx/v4"
)

// wire mounts the app with the v4-era CSRF re-exports (pre-upgrade shape).
func wire(mux *http.ServeMux) http.Handler {
	var csrfCfg cqrshtmx.CSRFConfig
	mux.Handle("POST /items", cqrshtmx.CSRFMiddleware(csrfCfg)(nil))

	token := cqrshtmx.CSRFToken
	_ = token

	return mux
}
